profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Backend Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience designing and implementing solutions in the financial and retail industries using Scrum Agile.

Known by my teams as a thoughtful and creative engineer, I take pride in delivering efficient and intuitive solutions I would personally want to use. 

Outside of work, I serve as a Regional Team Lead for the Vietnamese Eucharistic Youth Movement (VEYM), where I mentor developers and help design digital platforms supporting thousands of members nationwide.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborate with scrum team on the full implementation and launch of 5+ highly scalable Java Springboot gRPC APIs within a cloud distributed system for a flexible business SAAS product, leveraging Google Cloud Platform and MongoDB.
• On-call support engineer responsible for production stability during outages and resiliency plans to ensure high availability for production services.
• Automate complex system processes through multiple different components with robust monitoring and alerting, such as customer DNS entry creation and support 3+ external integrating teams through technical consulting and advising.

positions.title: Volunteer Technology Regional Lead for VEYM
positions.description:
• Oversee regional technology decisions and drive initiatives through team management.
• Administer full stack solutions through both design and implementation.
• Lead regional team of 6+ developers, manage work backlog, and work directly with stakeholders to understand IT needs
• Lead developer responsible for the delivery of the national HR management system responsible for 3,000+ members

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborate with scrum team on the full implementation and launch of Java services written upon Spring
• Design scalable REST APIs with detailed documentation to CRUD SQL databases with 5,000+ requests a day for 5+ calling applications.
• Implement features and bug fixes for .NET applications and REST services that handles 10,000+ sensitive customer records.
• Ensure system stability, application security, and code quality as application owner of a suite of .NET applications with 2000+ users.
• Enforce continuous integration and development patterns for 10+ applications to be used for timely delivery of code by 10+ teams
• Maintain repositories and environments with 100+ developers/testers.

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description:
• Provide application support of through incident ticket handling.
• Create proactive solutions by parsing 1000+ application/user log files and generating predictive metrics.
• Produced automated unit tests in xUnit and JUnit.

projects.title: VEYM Membership Platform
projects.description:
Led the design and development of a full-stack HR membership system for the Vietnamese Eucharistic Youth Movement (VEYM), serving over 6,000 members nationwide.

The platform centralizes user management, authentication, and organizational hierarchy using Azure B2C and Active Directory.

Built secure .NET Core APIs with role-based access control, automated CI/CD pipelines through Azure Pipelines, dashboards for data / traffic visualization, and implemented robust logging and monitoring for maintainability. The system delivers a fast, reliable, and secure experience that helps national and regional leaders manage operations efficiently.

Built upon SQL, .NET Core, and Next JS.

projects.title: Philips Nguyen | Master Class
projects.description:
Search-optimized coaching platform to promote personalized training services for competitive card game players.

Designed and deployed a responsive front end with seamless CMS integration to manage articles, client content, and media.

Built upon Next JS, Vercel, Directus, and Railway.

organizations.name: Vietnamese Eucharistic Youth Movement
organizations.position: Local Chapter Executive Board Member, Regional IT Chair  · Jan 2004 - Present
organizations.description:
The purpose of VEYM is to organize and to guide all youths in the Catholic Faith and to actively be involved in working for the good of society through charitable services and helping others.

• Certified youth leader per local arch diocese 
• Coordinate and help execute large scale events and projects for all divisions
